sections.heading: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: {{appName}} (the “Service”) lets you read and publish anonymous reviews of companies: culture, pay, management, benefits. The Service is available on the web and through the iOS and Android apps. These terms govern its use; accepting them is required to create an account.

sections.heading: 2. Access to the Service
paragraphs: Company pages and reviews can be read freely without an account.

Publishing a review, voting, reporting content or adding a company requires an account. You must be at least 16, provide a valid email address and create only one account. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential.

sections.heading: 3. Content rules
paragraphs: A review must describe your own, genuine experience at the company concerned, and remain factual and measured. Only one review per company is allowed per account; you can edit or delete it at any time.

The following are forbidden: names or details that identify a person (colleague, manager, client); accusations against a person; abusive, defamatory, discriminatory, hateful or threatening language; personal data (email, phone, address); confidential information or trade secrets; fake reviews (written by the company, a competitor, for payment or without having worked there); advertising; any unlawful content.

sections.heading: 4. Moderation and reporting
paragraphs: {{appName}} acts as a hosting provider (article 6 of the French law on confidence in the digital economy and the EU Digital Services Act). Reviews are not systematically checked before publication; automatic filters may however reject content or hold it for review.

Every review has a report button. Anyone may also notify unlawful content to {{abuseEmail}}, stating the page URL, the content concerned and the reasons. Clearly unlawful content is removed promptly. A review that receives many reports may be hidden pending review. Each author can see the status of their reviews from their account.
Repeated breaches of these rules may lead to the account being suspended or deleted.

sections.heading: 5. Anonymity
paragraphs: Your name and email address are never shown. Reviews are published without any identifier and dated to the month.

As a hosting provider, we are legally required to keep certain data identifying content authors and to disclose it to judicial authorities upon lawful request. Also avoid including details in your review that could reveal who you are.

sections.heading: 6. Your content
paragraphs: You keep the rights to your reviews. You grant the Service a non-exclusive, free, worldwide licence to host, reproduce and display them for as long as they are published. Deleting a review ends this licence.

sections.heading: 7. Reviewed companies
paragraphs: A company may report a review it considers unlawful or exercise a right of reply by writing to {{abuseEmail}}. No review can be removed or promoted in exchange for payment.

sections.heading: 8. Liability
paragraphs: Each author is solely responsible for the content they publish. The Service is provided as is; we strive to keep it available but cannot guarantee it.

sections.heading: 9. Account deletion
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time from the “My account” screen. Your reviews, votes and reports are then erased.

sections.heading: 10. Changes and governing law
paragraphs: These terms may change; significant changes will be announced in the Service.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Account: email address, password (stored hashed, never in plain text), creation and sign-in dates.

Contributions: reviews (ratings, texts, position, contract type, salary), “helpful” votes, reports and hidden authors. Reviews are published without any identifier; the link between your account and your reviews is kept internally so you can edit them, to enforce the one-review-per-company rule and to meet our legal obligations.
Anti-abuse data: when you publish, your IP address is recorded in hashed (irreversible) form to limit abuse. A bot check is performed by Cloudflare Turnstile.
Error reports: if the app crashes, technical information (device model, version, error trace) is sent to our diagnostics tool, without your email.
Usage analytics: only if you agree, we measure pages viewed and device type. These statistics are never linked to your account.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Providing the Service (account, publishing, votes, reports): performance of the terms of use.
Preventing spam and abuse, moderating content, securing the Service, diagnosing errors: legitimate interest.
Keeping data identifying content authors: legal obligation.
Usage analytics: consent, which you can withdraw at any time from your account.

sections.heading: 4. Recipients and processors
paragraphs: Your data is never sold. It is processed by our providers, strictly for their purpose:

Supabase (database and authentication), hosted in [TO COMPLETE: region, e.g. European Union, Frankfurt]; Cloudflare (bot check); OpenAI (automatic moderation: review text, without identifiers, is analysed in the United States, transfer covered by [TO COMPLETE: Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses]); Sentry (error reports); PostHog (usage analytics, EU hosting); Resend (email delivery); Expo (app updates and notifications); [TO COMPLETE: website host].
Judicial authorities may obtain certain data upon lawful request.

sections.heading: 5. Retention periods
paragraphs: Account, reviews and votes: until you delete your account.
Hashed IP addresses: 30 days.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object and port your data. Account deletion is available directly in the app. For other requests: {{contactEmail}}. You can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

sections.heading: 7. Security, cookies and trackers
paragraphs: Connections are encrypted, passwords are hashed and data access is restricted by database-level security rules.
The website stores your sign-in session (strictly necessary), your language and your consent choice locally. Usage analytics work without cookies and only after you agree.
